summary.text: Glenn Bailey is a Republican state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 2 who has served in the House since 2020, according to Ballotpedia, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Bailey and incumbent Peter Hayward defeated incumbent Abigail Rooney in the Republican primary for Strafford 1 on September 8, 2020, and then defeated Larry Brown in the general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Strafford 2, a three-seat district, in 2022, 2024 and 2026.
He was assigned to the House Executive Departments and Administration Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
Larry Brown (D) and Mark Racic (R) are also on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for the district.
